title: Proclamation No. 643, s. 2013
text:
MALACAÑAN PALACE MANILA

PROCLAMATION NO. 643

DECLARING WEDNESDAY, 18 SEPTEMBER 2013, AS A SPECIAL (NON-WORKING) DAY IN THE CITY OF TACURONG

WHEREAS, the City of Tacurong marks its 13th Cityhood Anniversary on 18 September 2013, dubbed as “Talakudong Festival 2013;”

WHEREAS, it is but fitting and proper that the people of the City of Tacurong be given full opportunity to celebrate and participate in the occasion with appropriate ceremonies.

NOW, THEREFORE, I, PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR., Executive Secretary, by authority of His Excellency, BENIGNO S. AQUINO III, do hereby declare Wednesday, 18 September 2013, as a special (non-working) day in the City of Tacurong.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.

Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of August, in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Thirteen.

By the authority of the President:

(Sgd.) PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR. Executive Secretary
